claims.claim_text: We experimented with randomly dropping out the imitation losses for a random subset of training examples, referred to as "imitation dropout".
claims.normalized_text: Imitation dropout randomly drops imitation losses during training for some examples.
claims.source_quote: To further increase the eﬀectiveness of the environment losses, we experimented with randomly dropping out the imitation losses for a random subset of training examples. We refer to this as “imitation dropout”.

claims.claim_text: Imitation dropout yields a better driving model than simply under-weighting the imitation losses.
claims.normalized_text: Imitation dropout improves driving model performance compared to under-weighting imitation losses.
claims.source_quote: In the experiments, we show that imitation dropout yields a better driving model than simply under-weighting the imitation losses.
